name: Ätran - Långesjön

difficulty.notes: The Swedish official page says blue difficulty and the English page says Blue. Official prose describes varied but generally easy surfaces: mostly forest roads, some rooted paths through dense spruce forest, wetland/boardwalk walking southwest of Långesjön, and no challenging hills.

routeType.notes: Fourth researched section of Mellersta delleden/Central inland branch in the local M numbering. The current official GPX starts in central Ätran and ends at Långesjön; old Eseredssjön-Långesjön naming persists in OSM, Naturkartan slug and route apps but is not the canonical current identity.
routeType.descriptionForAppDraft: From Ätran the trail follows Eseredssjön past the campsite before continuing through forest and farmland toward Krogsered. Lyngsjön offers bathing, a rest area, toilet and nearby shelter before the trail enters Hylte municipality, passes Brännvinsgölen and continues through forest, old local-history landscapes and wetland boardwalks to the Långesjön campsite. The route is mostly easy forest road and path, with some roots and wet ground, and has reliable drinking-water points at Ätran and Krogsered church rather than at the shelters.
